findings.issue: Bronze is an absolute noun after “the bases” and “for pillars,” with no construct or preposition tying it to the pillars. Spanish makes the columns bronze and does not give that material to the bases.
Silver follows the construct phrase whose head is the overlay of their heads. Spanish attaches the silver to the heads.
This pillars token is a preposition plus an absolute plural noun, with no definite article in the morphology. Spanish adds las.

notes: Hooks, bands, the pronoun, the pual participle, and all the pillars of the court match the tokens.
